objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object (policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, etc.) that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation and consecutive number identifying the document (e.g. RL_0001).

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, etc.).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level in the document pyramid (Level 1-4).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the document, incremented on each revision.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid, calculated from Valid From plus validity period.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Areas of validity or relevant companies for the document.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original file format of the document content (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Language of the document content.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period for which an invalidated document is retained before physical deletion (default 10 years).

attributes.name: validity_period
attributes.description: Period after which validity must be re-checked (default 3 years).

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document linked to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and is released together with the main document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary sub-document linked to a main document that is not subject to the release cycle and can be published directly via property switches.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Published or unpublished state of the additional information.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A formal proposal to amend an existing released document, managed independently from the document version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the change proposal (created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend, revise, or invalidate the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing state of the validity extension request.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate (put out of force) a document and archive it, processed through a workflow.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing state of the override request.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated and archived document, created by the Business Admin group.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing state of the reactivation request.

objs.name: author
objs.description: A user assigned as the primary responsible person for creating and maintaining a document.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: A user assigned additional personal change rights on a document alongside the author.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: A user responsible for checking the content of a document according to technical and/or formal aspects during the release workflow.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: A user responsible for final approval and release of a document, deciding whether it is distributed to readers.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: A user who translates released content into another language; cannot create new objects independently.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: A user who can only view approved/released documents, assigned via reader user groups on the distribution list.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users used to assign read or change authorizations and distribution roles for documents.

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Classification of the user group (e.g. Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive, Business Admin).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: The list of user groups and persons assigned to a document for email notification or acknowledgement upon release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by email (information only) or for acknowledgement (active confirmation required).

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process instance that guides a document or request through defined steps (Creator, Review, Release) with electronic signatures.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: The type of workflow (release, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement, translation release).

attributes.name: workflow_status
attributes.description: Current state of the workflow instance.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A recorded signature by a workflow participant, documented per released version for traceability and audit trail.

attributes.name: signer_role
attributes.description: Role of the person signing (author, reviewer, releaser).

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the signature was applied.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type, optionally containing TAG-based metadata placeholders, selected when creating new documents.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Reference data in the system (IT applications, organizational units, risks, processes) that can be linked to documents.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document information object is created in the system by selecting a document type and optionally a template.

attributes.name: document_type_selected
attributes.description: The document type chosen during creation.

attributes.name: template_selected
attributes.description: The template chosen during creation, if any.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated in the properties dialog.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office application.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step release workflow (Creator - Review - Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the first workflow step (Creator) with an electronic signature.

evts.name: perform_review
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document for technical and/or formal correctness and completes the review task.

attributes.name: review_outcome
attributes.description: Positive approval or rejection of the review.

evts.name: perform_release
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document, making it available for publication.

attributes.name: release_outcome
attributes.description: Positive approval or rejection of the release.

evts.name: reject_in_workflow
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, causing cancellation for all subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created when revisions are needed, retaining data from the previous version.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: An attachment sub-document is created and linked to a main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is created and linked to a main document without affecting its release cycle.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is deleted directly due to its non-critical nature.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for an existing released document by any user with author rights.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, triggering creation of a new document version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of a change proposal, marking it as completed and notifying the creator.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically creates a validity extension request 30 days before the document validity expires.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: The validity extension request is processed through a workflow, resulting in extended validity, revision, or invalidation.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Decision outcome: extend validity, revise document, or invalidate.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The document validity is extended by updating the Valid Until date, and the validity extension request is deleted.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates an override (invalidation) request for a document.

evts.name: process_override
evts.description: The override request is processed through a workflow to invalidate the document.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The document is declared out of force: the last released version receives the out-of-force status, edited versions are deleted, and rights are revoked except for the archive group.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A member of the Business Admin group creates a request to reactivate an invalidated document.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: The initiator confirms reactivation, creating a new version of the document with restored metadata, authorizations, and attachments.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are notified by email when a new document version is released.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are requested to actively confirm acknowledgement of the released document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a document via the workflow-supported acknowledgement task.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or change authorizations are assigned to user groups or individual persons for a document.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language by a translator.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated language version is checked and released through a workflow, making it visible to readers in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: physical_deletion
evts.description: After the archive duration expires, archived documents are physically deleted from the system.

o2o.description: An attachment is a controlled sub-document that belongs to a specific main document and is released with it.
Additional information is a supplementary object linked to a specific main document without affecting its release cycle.
A change proposal belongs to a specific document and proposes amendments to it.
A validity extension request is linked to the document whose validity needs to be checked.
An override request is created for a specific document to invalidate and archive it.
A reactivation request references a specific invalidated document to be reactivated.
A document may be created based on a specific document template.
A document can be linked to master data such as IT applications, organizational units, risks, and processes.
A document can reference other documents in the system.
A distribution list is maintained per document to control email notification and acknowledgement distribution.
A distribution list contains user groups whose members receive distribution notifications or acknowledgement requests.
Authors are offered for selection when assigned to the Authors user group by technical administration.
Reviewers are offered for selection when assigned to the Reviewer user group by technical administration.
Releasers are offered for selection when assigned to the Releaser user group by technical administration.
Readers are assigned read access to documents via reader user groups.
